custom.memory_above_system_limits:
You are launching Minecraft with \u003cstrong\u003e$XMX$\u003c/strong\u003e of allocated RAM, which exceeds your total available system memory (\u003cstrong\u003e$TOTAL_CAPACITY$\u003c/strong\u003e including Swap).
The game will be very unstable and prone to crashing. Please reduce your allocated memory.
custom.memory_below_recommended:
You are launching Minecraft with \u003cstrong\u003e$XMX$\u003c/strong\u003e of allocated RAM.
The modpack should be able to run, but you may encounter some freezing and slowness, especially after keeping the game open for a long time.
If your system can support it, visit your launcher settings and increase your memory allocation to \u003cstrong\u003e$RECOMMENDED$ GB\u003c/strong\u003e for a more stable experience.
custom.memory_below_minimum:
You are launching Minecraft with only \u003cstrong\u003e$XMX$\u003c/strong\u003e of allocated RAM.
That is not enough for this modpack, and you will experience long or indefinite load times, freezing, and crashes.
Please visit your launcher settings and allocate at least \u003cstrong\u003e$MINIMUM$ GB\u003c/strong\u003e, ideally \u003cstrong\u003e$RECOMMENDED$ GB\u003c/strong\u003e.
custom.high_system_load:
You are launching Minecraft with \u003cstrong\u003e$XMX$\u003c/strong\u003e of allocated RAM, but it seems your system memory is \u003cstrong\u003eheavily loaded\u003c/strong\u003e by other applications.
The amount of available memory (\u003cstrong\u003e$AVAILABLE$\u003c/strong\u003e) is less than what Minecraft might still need to reach its limit.
Please \u003cstrong\u003eclose unnecessary applications\u003c/strong\u003e (like browsers or other games) to prevent freezes and crashes.
custom.memory_above_maximum:
You are launching Minecraft with \u003cstrong\u003e$XMX$\u003c/strong\u003e of allocated RAM.
This is over the recommended amount so you may experience lag spikes.
This modpack typically uses \u003cstrong\u003e$RECOMMENDED$ GB\u003c/strong\u003e, and we recommend you reduce your allocation to \u003cstrong\u003e$RECOMMENDED$-$MAXIMUM$ GB\u003c/strong\u003e.
